 Prayer:

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o
 India praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondent
 grant the enhanced award compensation in respect of Survey No.153/1
 for an extent of 1231 Sqmt Gulur Village, Tiruttani Taluk, Thiruval
 District, as per petitioner's appeal dated 24.08.2023 and 22.07.202
 For Petitioner : Mr.C.Venkatesan
 For Respondents 1,3 & 4 : Mr.A.Selvendran,
 Special Government Pleader
 For 2nd Respondent : Mrs.S.R.Sumathy
 Order

This Writ Petition is filed for a mandamus to issue a direction to grant the enhanced award compensation in respect of Survey No.153/15B for an extent of 1231 SQMT Gulur Village, Tiruttani Taluk, Thiruvallur District, as per the petitioner's appeal dated 24.08.2023 and 22.07.2024.
2.
Heard the learned counsels on either side.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
An acquisition has been initiated under the provisions of the National Highways Act and the compensation has been determined under Section 3(G) of the said Act.
The order awarding compensation is akin to an award as the provisions of the Arbitration and conciliation Act is applicable to the proceedings under the National Highways Act.
Therefore, the remedy available is only to file an application as contemplated under provisions of the National Highways Act and the Writ Petition seeking enhancement is not maintainable.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
The Arbitrator & District Collector, Thiruvallur, Thiruvallur District.
